name: interserver/mcp-openapi-core
description: Shared core for InterServer's MCP servers: OpenAPI-to-tools translation, upstream proxying, and OAuth resource-server auth.

scripts.lint: @php -r "foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator(__DIR__)) as $f) { if ($f->getExtension() === 'php' && !str_contains($f->getPathname(), '/vendor/')) { exec('php -l ' . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $o, $rc); if ($rc !== 0) { echo implode(PHP_EOL, $o), PHP_EOL; exit(1); } } } echo 'lint ok', PHP_EOL;"
